title: Snap SPECS unveiled at AWE: US$2,195, pre-order, ships this fall; two colour + two IR cameras
detail: Snap SPECS unveiled at AWE: US$2,195, pre-order, ships "this fall" in US/UK/France; two full-colour high-resolution cameras plus two IR cameras; Snap gave no camera specs. Second source: https://www.techtimes.com/article

title: Snap SPECS event: shipping later this fall in US/UK/France; no puck or tether
detail: "Shipping is expected to begin later this fall in the United States, United Kingdom and France"; "computing hardware built directly into the glasses without a puck or tether".
